fusions.name: Horn Check
fusions.desc: A head-down blow that deals 15 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Ledge Stamp
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Anything struck moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Stubborn Stand
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cliff Hold
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. You have 6% physical resistance.
